Title: Beginner tips
Body: Fishing is definitely worth it. Eventually you'll get a better rod and be able to use bait and tackle. Beginning game I usually farm parsnips, keep one and five gold stars, and save up money for the egg festival so you can buy a lot of strawberry seeds. The more you interact with the game, the more you'll unlock! [...] There's a map that tells you what time different buildings are open and where everything (and the farmer) is. There's a tab to let you know who you've talked to and who you've given gifts to. Also watch your tv every day!
Label: Gameplay Tip

Title: Re: What the hell do I do with my greenhouse?
Body: Any crop that either makes you say 'boy, this is so profitable, I wish I had this all year' or 'boy, this takes so long to grow, I wish I didn't have to plant it on exactly Fall 1 to yield anything'. Ancient berries mostly, also star fruit and sweet gem. And fruit trees, which can grow outside of the dirt to save space. I also have 1 corn plant in there for oil and 1 blueberry bush for easy villager gifts.
Label: Gameplay Tip

Title: Re: Just unlocked what's the best use for the green house?
Body: imo ancient fruit is more profitable in the long run bc they continue to produce without needing to be replanted, whereas with starfruit you either have to buy new seeds every harvest or turn half of your harvest into seeds to replant & therefore lose half of your product.
Label: Gameplay Tip

Title: Re: Late-game tips?
Body: Do less crops and less animals. Use sprinklers and Junimo Huts to automate your farm a bit. Grow crops that take a LONG time to grow, or only grow stuff on Ginger Island and the Greenhouse so you can have crops from any season, based on what you need. Autopetters and Autocollectors make animals more manageable so you can largely ignore them while the grabbers just gather their produce.
Label: Gameplay Tip

Title: Re: Tips and thoughts for the greenhouse?
Body: Beautiful!! I only do fruit that gives multiple harvests so I never have to replant (ancient fruit, blueberries, strawberries, pineapple, cranberries, cactus, peppers, idk if I missed one). Save Ancient fruit for wine and I stick the rest all in the dehydrator! Veggies became useless for processing when I started cranking out aged roe in the preserve jars.
Label: Gameplay Tip

Title: List of Pro Tips & Non-Obvious Mechanics
Body: Hold seed bags to replant the tiles simultaneously, saving time. Junimos can phase through trellis crops to harvest, so you can plant them without gaps. Remember they don't harvest when it's raining. [...] If a pet/villager is blocking your path, keep walking into them. They vibrate at first, & after a moment, allow you to phase through.
Label: Gameplay Tip

Title: Re: Late-game tips?
Body: if the crops feel like too much, you can do a year/season of not sowing seeds, the animals can be sold if they start being too much, just because you've been doing a thing doesn't mean you need to keep at it, you can just switch your focus & return to those when you have the time. You can also demolish your farm buildings if they're too distracting or in the way...
Label: Gameplay Tip

Title: Re: What do you grow in your greenhouse?
Body: Don't have to harvest fruit trees every day, they can hold up to three fruits before they stop producing, so you only have to harvest them twice a week or so!
Label: Gameplay Tip

Title: I wish I knew you couldn't walk through beanpoles before buying 200 of them.
Body: Are there any other crops that behave like this? I've had to scatter them and now my OCD is through the roof.

Title: Re: I wish I knew earlier
Body: If you're going around the forest collecting wood I highly recommend planting all the tree seeds you get as you cut them down! Then next time you go around the forest there will be plenty more trees to cut. I wish I thought of this earlier and not like in year 4 lol.
Label: Gameplay Tip

Title: Best crops to plant in greenhouse?
Body: I usually fill half of the greenhouse with Ancient fruit, a quarter with coffee, and the last quarter divided between 3 hops, some cactus fruit, and some plots for rare seeds (sweet gem berries), and 1-3 strawberry plants.
Label: Gameplay Tip

Title: Re: What the hell do I do with my greenhouse?
Body: The greenhouse allows you to grow any crop from any season, meaning you could grow pumpkins in spring, for example. You can place sprinklers in there too. The most common use is having very valuable crops growing all year which you turn into wines, the most common are ancient fruit and starfruit for this.
Label: Gameplay Tip

Body: It is not worth it on its own imo. I hate that it also doesn't stop tree seeds from planting and growing. But in terms of perfection, it's essential so when I'm doing that I go for it.

Body: Fishing, fishing, fishing. Honestly, if you spend the first two weeks just fishing down at the mountain lake (chubs and largemouth bass), you can buy enough strawberry seeds at the Egg Festival to snowball your economy.

Title: Re: Is the golden clock worth it?

Body: If you have the burglar ring, you don't need them. But if you breed white slimes indoors, they drop diamonds when you cull them. It's more of a fun side hobby than a real money maker.

Title: Stardew Valley review
Body: TL;DR: Start off poor, grow tons of cool plants, fight monsters, give sweet gifts to hot guys/gals and romance them, compete in sweet festivals, but more importantly create the farm and non-corporate Joja lifestyle of your dreams! Build basically any farm you want, or don't farm at all and just go fishing/mining/fighting monster.. It's all completely viable.
Label: Opinion / Discussion

Title: Re: New to Stardew Valley
Body: Take it at your own pace. There are no hard time limits besides repeatable side quests. Get back in bed before 2am or you'll pass out. The start is a bit slow due to your lack of stamina and stamina-restoring options, but these improve vastly as you progress through the game.
Label: Gameplay Tip

Title: Re: Anyone got tips for a returning player?
Body: Weather might not be super important, but early on, knowing when rain is coming is a big help -- those are the days you upgrade your watering can (use it the day before the rain but make sure you put it in for the upgrade before the rain comes; let Clint work on it through the rainy day, and get it back the next day).
Label: Gameplay Tip

Title: Re: Anyone got tips for a returning player?
Body: When you got the fiberglass rod, go fishing by the Mountain Lake. Don't try to catch catfish before you got an Iridium Rod. I suggest you try catfish when fishing lv8. If you can catch catfish before fishing lv6, maybe you should try the Dark Souls.
Label: Gameplay Tip

Title: Re: What should I do with my greenhouse?
Body: From a pure profit perspective, Hops are one of the most profitable things you can grow in your greenhouse because they produce daily. Brew those hops into pale ale, and you've got a rather lucrative business.
Label: Gameplay Tip

Title: Re: What should I do with my greenhouse?
Body: Strawberries, blueberries, and cranberries are all good choices for the greenhouse. Strawberries are loved gifts for Demetrius and Maru so I usually have at least a few. I tend to use several greenhouse plots just for loved gifts. Peppers are a loved gift for Lewis & Shane.
Label: Gameplay Tip

Title: Re: Greenhouse
Body: If the Fertilizer is on the Ancient Fruit's soil at the time you harvest it, the fruit quality will benefit from the Fertilizer. Since crops never die in the Greenhouse, that Fertilizer will work permanently on your Ancient Fruit plants. However if you process Ancient Fruit into Wine or Jelly, you lose the benefit of any quality improvements.
Label: Gameplay Tip

Title: Re: Completing the Greenhouse During the First Year
Body: At that point, use all your wild seeds, wood and fiber to make tea saplings, and sell them. BOOM, money. You can have delux barn, coop and all the animals before the end of fall, if you work on forage wood, fiber (in mines, when you finish the plants around the map) and plants to make the wild seed.
Label: Gameplay Tip

Title: Completing the Greenhouse During the First Year
Body: I play with the standard farm. The insurmountable hurdle I have in completing the Greenhouse is to obtain all the requirements for the animal bundle. As I understand it, you need to purchase a large milk from the Traveling cart, which I am almost always able to do. If not, then you need to build a barn as well as a Deluxe coop.
Label: Story / Experience

Title: Re: I'm new! is there any tips for newcomer?
Body: Befriend Caroline to two hearts, then go through the door in the general store kitchen for a scene and a crafting recipe. Tea saplings sell for 250 G. Mayonnaise makers, Cheese presses, Preserves jar, and Kegs are all worth crafting and using to make more money from your raw produce.
Label: Gameplay Tip

Title: Re: Best small tips
Body: Don't forget to plant 'green rain' (wild) trees, next to your tree orchards (they make moss appear faster on other trees). And always put mushroom logs, inbetween rows of tapped trees. Beehouses are best placed on Ginger island, where fairy roses don't wither.
Label: Gameplay Tip

Title: Re: tips for early game
Body: Walk around. Talk to people, go everywhere the game lets you, interact with everything that looks interactable (I couldn't figure out how to buy seeds for a whole in-game year when I started so yea). Check out the abandoned building near the fountain and the glowing thingy in it. Get a training rod at the fishing shop on the beach, it's 25 g and will make it easier immediately if you need to.
Label: Gameplay Tip

Title: My Greenhouse Is Gone!
Body: So my current save that I am playing on is in the winter of year 2, so I can't really just start over because I would lose a ton of progress. At the beginning of this save, I had changed my farm type using Stardew Valley Editor. This was the only time I ever used it, to change the farm type and now my greenhouse has completely vanished.
Label: Question

Title: Re: Best small tips
Body: For friendship, put some chests with loved gifts close to where you meet NPCs regularly (e.g. in the mountains for Linus and Robins family, one near Emily's and Jodi's houses for their families, etc.) every time you walk past, give out gifts.
Label: Gameplay Tip

Title: Re: Best small tips
Body: Do not push yourself to achieve anything especially perfection. Once you are wealthy enough or achieve everything, the experience of playing this game comes to end. Take some time to check Wiki or tutorial videos made by experts, you will be more efficient to experience the game.
Label: Opinion / Discussion

Title: Re: What are the first things I should do in this game
Body: First thing I would do if you haven't already is plant the parsnips that you receive at the start of your game. Then water them once a day and you should have some crops ready to harvest by day 5.
Label: Gameplay Tip

Title: Re: What are the first things I should do in this game
Body: The best part of stardew for me is that there is literally no right or wrong way to play. sometimes I load it up and just fish for a few irl hours or go mining. Dont worry too much about doing anything perfect on your first go around.
Label: Opinion / Discussion

Title: Re: Tips for beginners?
Body: Save at least one or two of everything you find or grow (you need them for quests). You can give people two gifts every week. Each gift has a value, Individuals like and dislike different things. Liked gifts will increase the degree to which they like you
Label: Gameplay Tip

Title: Re: Tips for beginners?
Body: The game is over five years old, there are beginner guides and huge lists of tips all over the internet. Even on this very forum. You can easily find those by using the search function at the right side. I'd still rather hear it from the community directly because I can avoid spoilers this way.
Label: Opinion / Discussion

Title: Re: I'm new to the game any beginner tips
Body: Buy 100 strawberry seeds is easier said than done. To be able to buy 100 strawberry seeds you need to get your crops off to a very rapid start. Plant your starter pack of pasnip seeds the head to the store. On the way pick up all forage in along the path and sell it in the store.
Label: Gameplay Tip

Title: Re: I'm new to the game any beginner tips
Body: Friday and Sunday -> check Cindersap Forest (location in south from your farm) for Traveling Cart. Most of goods are overpriced, but you can find at least 1 (and up to 5 in lucky days) Rare Seed. Those can be purchased for 1000g each
Label: Gameplay Tip

Title: Re: Any beginner tips?
Body: The way to get tons of money is to stop starting over. You don't even need any tricks. The knowledge people are sharing here is good, but you don't need it. You just keep planting, keep expanding, keep exploring, and figure it our for yourself.
Label: Opinion / Discussion

Title: Re: Any beginner tips?
Body: I tend to put chests everywhere, but got more cautious about that when something destroyed the chest I had near the community center (it was not in the path of a townie which I know is a no-no). Now I only put them on my farm (all exits) or on the top level of the caves.
Label: Gameplay Tip

Title: Beginner Junimo Cart Tips
Body: As for the first level, I would say that the main thing to learn it how far you jump depending on how long you press the jump button. The fruits do different stuff in the modes. In progress mode collecting all three fruits will give an extra life.
Label: Gameplay Tip

Title: Re: Ginger Island [Beginner]
Body: Wear as much protective clothing from the mainland (space boots, slime charmer ring can really help as the tiger slimes are abundant and deal a lot of extra damage while you fight off the flames/sparklers, napalm ring if you have, rock crab ring if not.) Use Galaxy Sword if have, Lava Kantina if not.
Label: Gameplay Tip

Title: Re: Starting a new game

Title: Re: Groundhog day bug
Body: It has been confirmed that it only happens when two things are present: 1) One of the tools aren't in your inventory, and. 2) One of your chests/fridge has a blank space between items. So basically, just make sure that when you don't have every tool in your inventory that there aren't any blank spaces between items in any of your chests.
Label: Gameplay Tip

Title: Re: What could SoS learn from Stardew Valley?
Body: What they really need to do is streamline the farming and animal care. Stardew is the only BokuMono-style game where taking care of animals isn't mind-numbing. You can pretty much leave them alone with minimal negative consequences. Autofeeder means you never have to manually feed them.
Label: Opinion / Discussion

Title: Re: 8 years later finally got it!
Body: I put a gold-quality Leek in the Luau soup, having forgotten that most forageables don't score well even if they're high-quality, and it only made 'average' soup. I sat and mentally debated with myself whether to reset the day, because I am cursed with knowing exactly how many easy friendship points I missed out on

Title: Re: Please read the wiki (:

Title: Re: FAQs and beginner questions
Body: Next thing to remember is that your farm has 3 exits: North goes to the Mountains, which has Robin's house, Linus's tent, the mines, the train station, the mountain lake, the adventurer's guild, and the quarry. East goes to the bus stop. South goes to the Forest.
Label: Gameplay Tip

Title: Re: FAQs and beginner questions
Body: If I feel like checking the Wikia more often then I check what crops are good for gifting and save even more gold ones. You get more friendship gifting better quality. Otherwise I use normal quality for artisan goods and sell all my silver quality.
Label: Gameplay Tip

Title: Stardew Valley Review for PC
Body: The basic gear treadmill is in play here. You start with a basic set of tools and continually upgrade them so you can farm more and faster. Eventually you can raise livestock and distill wine. When these activities bore you, you can slay monsters in the mines, fish, or eventually explore a desert and tropical island.
Label: Opinion / Discussion

Title: Stardew Valley Review for Android
Body: Time management is a central mechanic of Stardew Valley, and you decide just what you want to invest your time in and how you earn gold. Here's a hint: A solid way to generate gold quickly in Stardew Valley is to have machines closely grouped together and near their associated producers.
Label: Opinion / Discussion

Title: Re: I caught 999 of every fish in iridium quality.
Body: That is insane dedication. I usually just catch one of each for the perfection tracker and never touch the fishing rod again. Do you use the trap bobber or cork bobber mostly?

Title: It's salmonberry season in the PNW :)
Body: IRL pic of some salmonberries I found while hiking! They look exactly like the ones in the game. I almost expected to hear the little pop sound effect when I picked them.

Title: Re: FAQ and Beginner Questions Thread
Body: Generally things will decay very slowly, but if you don't water your crops for a day they just don't grow. Crops don't die, they don't go backwards or anything if you skip watering. They just don't progress forward BUT if they aren't fully grown and harvested by the end of the season then they die.
Label: Gameplay Tip

Title: Re: Missing tool
Body: If you lost a tool, check your fridge or any random chests around the map you might have left it in. If it's truly gone, Mayor Lewis usually sends it back to you in the mail the next morning, or you can check the lost and found box in his house.
Label: Gameplay Tip

Title: Re: What's the point of Green Rain?
Body: I like the mixed flower seeds. Mixed flower seeds in fall give fairy rose and sunflower. I tend to gather 30+ on that day for the next season which is enough to never need to buy those thanks to the seed maker. It is also the only source of those green rain tree seeds and is an easy source of moss and fiber in bulk for crafting purposes.
Label: Gameplay Tip

Title: Re: Any tips on how to make the most of the 'Green Rain'?
Body: I eat a food with a Foraging buff and then go harvest all the fiber and moss in the area. I feel like I constantly need weeds and moss in this run. If you're only going for fiber and moss, they can both be collected with just the scythe, which uses no energy.
Label: Gameplay Tip

Title: Re: Everyone's opinion on green rain?
Body: Free moss by the motherlode = cheap early mushroom stump farm = unlimited profits from dehydrated shrooms several seasons/years before wine in bulk becomes a viable strategy. Green rain is the 🐐
Label: Opinion / Discussion

Title: Re: Everyone's opinion on green rain?
Body: Took me a while to figure this out, but the extra trees that grow in town during the green rain can be chopped down! Pretty sure they disappear if you don't chop them down. This doesn't include the ones up by Robin's workshop, just the one literally in town.
Label: Gameplay Tip

Title: Re: Things to do during green rain?
Body: There's a crafting recipe later on that you WILL want that needs 333 moss and 999 fiber. But you'll likely get your second green rain by the time you want to craft it. But also, it's used for mushroom logs, deluxe bait, and the deluxe worm bin. It can go pretty fast when you're crafting those things!
Label: Gameplay Tip

Title: Re: Farming clay in 1.6
Body: This was not the purpose of farming clay pre 1.6. People were farming clay to get early gold in year one to buy raw materials before they became more expensive in year two. Or for obscure challenge runs. 1.6 changed how some RNG systems worked, so the clay spawn positionings became much less predictable unless legacy RNG is turned on.
Label: Gameplay Tip

Title: Re: Farming clay in 1.6
Body: Just curious, why would people want to farm clay? That stuff is lying around in the hundreds for me and I never found any use for it aside from making a few Garden Pots.
Label: Question

Title: Re: Farming clay in 1.6
Body: I am trying to make 200 mils in the first two years again in 1.6, and it has been just too difficult, because I can't generate enough clays to build enough large sheds. If I can gather 6,550 clays (25 large sheds with 131 starfruits) by the end of spring year 2, I think I can make 200 mils again.
Label: Story / Experience

Title: Re: 1.6 clay farming
Body: If you still want to be able to clay farm you'll need to select 'Legacy Randomization' in the Advanced Options when you're creating your character - otherwise CA updated the 'randomness' coding that was previously in the game so the pattern for clay farming no longer exists.
Label: Gameplay Tip

Title: Re: Clay farming tricks in 1.6
Body: Clay nodes from the dig site do 'ok' but you have to wait for them to replenish. I'm actually finding that Treasure Totems do a pretty good job of generating clay. Not entirely sure where's best for them, but according to the Wiki the range is 20-60% of spots will be clay.
Label: Gameplay Tip

Title: Re: Clay farming tricks in 1.6
Body: Garden pots and deluxe retaining soil and fiber seeds. A shed full of garden pots with pinapples produces a useful quantity all year round, in a 7x3 footprint. You can also fill your house with garden pots too - I particularly like having a 'kitchen garden' with veg for cooking with.
Label: Gameplay Tip

Title: Re: There has to be a better way to clay farm ahhhhhhhh
Body: The day you can get 300 clay with the farming is over, but you can still get about 100 clay per day with an iridium hoe and generous perk. I go to the 15th floor, use hoe 4 times, return to the 0th floor, and repeat. I hope there are better ways to do so, but it's the best one I know in 1.6.
Label: Gameplay Tip

Title: Re: There has to be a better way to clay farm ahhhhhhhh
Body: Only played a few years in game, what do you even need clay for? I've got a few hundred in a chest.
Label: Question

Title: Re: There has to be a better way to clay farm ahhhhhhhh
Body: You can burn through quite a lot of clay if you are decorating with brick. Also growing crops in pots is clay intensive. More so if you are growing anything other than tea or fiber. If you need a lot of deluxe retaining soil then that will also use up a lot of clay.
Label: Gameplay Tip

Title: What happens when you give a bouquet to everyone?
Body: I am currently dating all 6 bachelors at the same time because I couldn't decide. I know there's a group 10-heart event in the saloon. Is there a way to avoid getting dumped or getting the bad cold-shoulder dialogue? I heard carrying a rabbit's foot changes it?
Label: Question

Title: Re: What happens when you give a bouquet to everyone?
Body: Yes! If you have a Rabbit's Foot in your inventory when you enter the saloon, the event turns into a friendly game of pool instead of them all confronting you. It completely saves you from the negative friendship penalty.
Label: Gameplay Tip

Title: I am so sick of Marnie never being at her shop
Body: It's Monday afternoon. My cows are literally starving because I ran out of hay, and Marnie is just staring at her microwave. Then tomorrow is Tuesday and she goes to aerobics at Caroline's house. Why can't we just have an automated catalog like Pierre's?
Label: Opinion / Discussion

Title: Re: I am so sick of Marnie never being at her shop
Body: If you play on 1.6, you can actually buy Marnie's Shop Catalogue from her eventually! It lets you access her shop even when she isn't at the counter. Until then, you just have to memorize her schedule: Mondays and Tuesdays she is closed.
Label: Gameplay Tip

Title: Re: I am so sick of Marnie never being at her shop
Body: This is why I buy 1000 hay from her in the Fall and just hoard it in a chest next to the silo. Relying on her schedule on Winter Day 1 is a rookie mistake we all make exactly once.
Label: Gameplay Tip

Title: How do I get to the Mastery Cave?
Body: I see a door carved into the cliffside in Cindersap Forest, near the bottom right by the sewer pipe. It says I need to master my skills first. I have level 10 in everything, why won't it open?
Label: Question

Title: Re: How do I get to the Mastery Cave?
Body: Level 10 isn't enough, you have to completely fill the total leveling bar to unlock the Mastery system. Once you earn enough 'post-level 10' experience, you'll get a prompt saying you've leveled up, and then the door will open. It takes 10,000 XP for the first point.
Label: Gameplay Tip

Title: Re: How do I get to the Mastery Cave?
Body: Once you get in, go for the Foraging mastery first. The Iridium Scythe makes clearing fiber and harvesting crops so much faster, and it harvests all crops, not just trellis ones.
Label: Gameplay Tip

Title: Re: How do I get to the Mastery Cave?
Body: Combat mastery gives you the Anvil and the Mini-Forge blueprints, which are essential if you want to optimize your trinkets. The parrot egg trinket is amazing for farming gold from monsters.
Label: Gameplay Tip

Title: Is the Joja route actually better for min-maxing?
Body: I've played 4 files completing the Community Center, but I'm thinking of doing a Joja run for pure speed. It feels bad to destroy the town's spirit, but buying the greenhouse for 35,000g instead of waiting on animal products seems way faster.
Label: Opinion / Discussion

Title: Re: Is the Joja route actually better for min-maxing?
Body: It is objectively faster for min-maxing. You can unlock the greenhouse by late Spring Year 1 if you just fish and spam parsnips/strawberries. You don't have to RNG the traveling cart or wait for a deluxe barn to get truffles.
Label: Gameplay Tip

Title: Re: Is the Joja route actually better for min-maxing?
Body: Plus, you get to keep the JojaMart open late, and you can buy Auto-Petters directly from Morris for 50,000g instead of grinding Skull Cavern treasure floors for a 1/25 Good Luck drop.
Label: Gameplay Tip

Title: Re: Is the Joja route actually better for min-maxing?
Body: The trade-off is you don't get the individual bundle rewards like the charcoal kiln or the crystalarium, but by the time you have that much cash, you can just craft them anyway. It changes the game into a pure money simulator though.
Label: Opinion / Discussion

Title: Where is the Bookseller?
Body: The map says the Bookseller is in town today, but I looked everywhere near Pierre's and the beach and can't find him. Where does his balloon land?
Label: Question

Title: Re: Where is the Bookseller?
Body: He lands on the northeast side of town, up the stairs behind JojaMart (or where JojaMart used to be if you did the Community Center). He only comes twice a season, check your calendar!
Label: Gameplay Tip

Title: Re: Where is the Bookseller?
Body: Save up your money for the 'Book of Stars' or the horse speed book. The one that gives you a running speed boost when eating crops is also a massive quality of life upgrade early game.
Label: Gameplay Tip

Title: How do I trigger the Raccoon quests?
Body: I got a text notification that a strong wind blew down a tree during the night in the forest. I went down and there's a big stump now. Do I just wait for something to spawn there?
Label: Question

Title: Re: How do I trigger the Raccoon quests?
Body: You need to fix the stump first! Bring 100 hardwood to it to build the Raccoon House. A few days later, a raccoon will move in and start asking you for specific seasonal forage and dried goods.
Label: Gameplay Tip

Title: Re: How do I trigger the Raccoon quests?
Body: The rewards are totally worth it. The raccoon wife sells unique seeds like carrot, summer squash, broccoli, and powdery melon depending on the season, and you need those for cooking achievements.
Label: Gameplay Tip

Title: Desert Festival layout and strategies
Body: I'm on Spring 15 and the Desert Festival just started. There's so much going on, what should I prioritize? The scholar's quiz? The skull cavern races? I only have 3 days.
Label: Question

Title: Re: Desert Festival layout and strategies
Body: Do the chef's daily meal first! You get a free buff that lasts the entire day based on the ingredients you choose. I usually go for the mining and speed combinations.
Label: Gameplay Tip

Title: Re: Desert Festival layout and strategies
Body: Bet your Calico Eggs on the skull cavern races. Look at the status of the legal/illegal modifications on the signs before choosing a monster. The sneaky paths make the snail win surprisingly often.
Label: Gameplay Tip

Title: Re: Desert Festival layout and strategies
Body: Don't forget to buy the unique outfits from the villager shops. Every day two different villagers set up shop and sell personal items. You can literally buy Robin's cargo pants or Elliott's old shirts.
Label: Gameplay Tip

Title: SquidFest tips - how many squids do I need?
Body: Winter 12 started and I'm at the beach for SquidFest. The bar moves so fast for squids. What's the target count for the iridium prize tier on day 2?
Label: Question

Title: Re: SquidFest tips - how many squids do I need?
Body: Day 1 requires fewer squids for the top prize, but Day 2 requires 10 squids for the Iridium tier. Definitely use a Squid Lure if you have one, and eat Seafoam Pudding to make your fishing bar larger.
Label: Gameplay Tip

Title: Re: SquidFest tips - how many squids do I need?
Body: The rewards are great for early game. You get mystery boxes, a book that makes squids sell for more, and a unique squid hat. If you miss Day 1, you can still get the Day 2 prizes.
Label: Gameplay Tip

Title: Trout Derby vs SquidFest
Body: Which mini-festival do you guys think is better? I personally preferred the Trout Derby in Summer because catching rainbow trout feels way less frustrating than dealing with winter squid physics.
Label: Opinion / Discussion

Title: Re: Trout Derby vs SquidFest
Body: Trout Derby is better because you can get golden tags that you trade for prizes, and you can hoard them or farm them all day long. The mystery boxes and tent kit rewards are awesome for a Summer Year 1 save.
Label: Opinion / Discussion

Title: Re: Trout Derby vs SquidFest
Body: Agreed, the tackle reward from Trout Derby let me stock up on spinner baits for the rest of the year without having to craft them or buy them from Willy.
Label: Opinion / Discussion

Title: What are Mystery Boxes?
Body: I started finding these green boxes with question marks on them while mining and chopping trees. Clint says he can crack them open, but are they worth the 25g processing fee?
Label: Question

Title: Re: What are Mystery Boxes?
Body: Yes, they contain everything from regular seeds and mixed seeds to high-end items like quality fertilizer, coffee beans, and even rare dishes like pepper poppers. It's basically a free loot box.
Label: Gameplay Tip

Title: Re: What are Mystery Boxes?
Body: If you read the book 'Mystery Box Guide' from the Bookseller, it increases your chances of finding better loot inside them. Later on, you can even find Deluxe Mystery Boxes which have insane drop tables.
Label: Gameplay Tip

Title: How to find all 130 Golden Walnuts
Body: I'm stuck at 127/130 walnuts on Ginger Island. Leo's parrot stops giving me hints and just squawks. How do I find the last three if the bird won't tell me?
Label: Question

Title: Re: How to find all 130 Golden Walnuts
Body: If the parrot is silent, it means the remaining walnuts are from the gorilla shrine, the banana altar, winning the darts game with the pirates on a rainy night, or the gem birds puzzle in the rainy forest.
Label: Gameplay Tip

Title: Re: How to find all 130 Golden Walnuts
Body: Don't forget to check the bushes in the secret paths. There's one hidden in the foliage just south of the volcano entrance, and another one hidden in the trees by the farmhouse wreck.
Label: Gameplay Tip

Title: Volcano Dungeon Forge combinations
Body: Finally cleared the 10 floors of the volcano. What are the best enchantments to roll on my Galaxy Sword? Should I go for Crusader or Vampiric?
Label: Question

Title: Re: Volcano Dungeon Forge combinations
Body: Crusader is widely considered the best because it lets you permanently kill mummies without needing bombs. It also deals 50% extra damage to shadows and skeletons, which makes high-level Skull Cavern runs way smoother.
Label: Gameplay Tip

Title: Re: Volcano Dungeon Forge combinations
Body: For tools, put Swift on your pickaxe and bottomless on your watering can. For weapons, combine three rubies onto your sword first for pure damage, then roll for the Crusader enchantment using a prismatic shard.
Label: Gameplay Tip

Title: Re: Volcano Dungeon Forge combinations
Body: If you use a hammer/club type weapon, go for Artful. It reduces the cooldown of the special heavy smash attack, meaning you can spam the ground slam and wipe out entire swarms of serpents.
Label: Gameplay Tip

Title: How does Qi Seasoning work?
Body: I bought Qi Seasoning from the Walnut Room. Does it automatically apply to everything I cook, or do I have to place it in the kitchen inventory?
Label: Question

Title: Re: How does Qi Seasoning work?
Body: You just need to keep it in your inventory or inside your kitchen fridge while you cook. It will automatically consume one seasoning per dish and upgrade the product to gold quality, boosting its buffs and health benefits.
Label: Gameplay Tip

Title: Re: How does Qi Seasoning work?
Body: Gold quality Triple Shot Espresso and Spicy Eel are a game changer. The speed buffs last significantly longer, so you don't have to keep stopping to eat in the middle of a deep cavern dive.
Label: Gameplay Tip

Title: Which Qi Challenge is easiest?
Body: I just unlocked the Walnut Room board. I have 'Qi's Crop' (500 fruit), 'Let's Play a Game' (Junimo Kart score), and 'Danger in the Deep' (mine reset). Which one should I pick for quick Qi Gems?
Label: Question

Title: Re: Which Qi Challenge is easiest?
Body: Four Precious Stones is the absolute easiest if you already have a stack of prismatic shards hoarded. You just turn in 4 shards immediately and get 40 Qi gems instantly.
Label: Gameplay Tip

Title: Re: Which Qi Challenge is easiest?
Body: Danger in the Deep is the most fun. It resets the regular mines to a high-difficulty version with new monsters and radio-active ore spawns. Elevators still work once you clear down every 5 floors, so you have a whole week.
Label: Gameplay Tip

Title: Re: Which Qi Challenge is easiest?
Body: Do NOT pick the Junimo Kart one unless you are an arcade god. It will cause real-life emotional damage. Qi's Crop is easy but it takes over your entire farm layout for a season.
Label: Opinion / Discussion

Title: Grandpa's Evaluation criteria
Body: It's Winter 28 of Year 2 and Grandpa's ghost is coming tonight. I only have 3 candles lit right now. What's the easiest way to get the 4th candle without waiting forever?
Label: Question

Title: Re: Grandpa's Evaluation criteria
Body: Earning 1,000,000g total lifetime earnings gives you a massive chunk of points. Also having 10 skills total across your professions or completing the community center. If you miss it, just stick a diamond in the shrine to re-evaluate anytime.
Label: Gameplay Tip

Title: Re: Grandpa's Evaluation criteria
Body: Getting married and having a fully upgraded house also counts for points. Once you get all 4 candles, interact with the shrine to get the Statue of Perfection, which gives you free iridium ore every morning.
Label: Gameplay Tip

Title: How to catch the Glacierfish
Body: I'm at the south tip of Arrowhead Island in Cindersap Forest during Winter. I have level 10 fishing and the iridium rod, but this fish is jumping like crazy. Any specific tackle recommendations?
Label: Question

Title: Re: How to catch the Glacierfish
Body: Trap bobber is non-negotiable for Glacierfish. It makes the escape bar drain slower when you aren't actively reeling it in. Also eat a Seafoam Pudding brewed with Qi Seasoning if you can get it to push your fishing level to 14.
Label: Gameplay Tip

Title: Re: How to catch the Glacierfish
Body: Make sure you cast into the deepest water possible (maximum distance cast). The legendary fish have specific tile distance requirements to trigger their spawns.
Label: Gameplay Tip

Title: Leo's house decoration ideas
Body: Leo finally moved to the mainland and got his little treehouse next to Linus. I want to decorate the area around his treehouse to make him feel welcome. What items match his jungle vibe?
Label: Question

Title: Re: Leo's house decoration ideas
Body: Use exotic plants from the island trader, mahogany trees, and lots of wild grass. You can also place some seasonal decor or parrot skeletons if you want to keep his island roots alive.
Label: Gameplay Tip

Title: Re: Leo's house decoration ideas
Body: Just make sure you don't place anything directly in Linus's walking path when he goes down to the lake, or he will plow right through your furniture and destroy it.
Label: Gameplay Tip

Title: Where to find the Ostrich Egg
Body: I've searched every chest in the Volcano Dungeon and killed dozens of magma sprites but I still haven't found an ostrich egg. Is it a pure RNG drop?
Label: Question

Title: Re: Where to find the Ostrich Egg
Body: It's not just RNG! You can get a guaranteed one by solving Journal Scrap #10. Go to the north side of the island by the volcano, and dig in the center of the stone circle. You need the Ostrich Incubator from Professor Snail to hatch it though.
Label: Gameplay Tip

Title: Re: Where to find the Ostrich Egg
Body: To get the incubator recipe, you have to complete all the fossil collections at the Island Field Office and complete Professor Snail's island survey questions. Don't guess the answers or he gets sassy.
Label: Gameplay Tip

Title: Are Dinosaurs or Void Chickens better for profit?
Body: I have a spare deluxe coop and want to commit it entirely to one animal type. Void mayonnaise sells consistently, but dinosaur mayonnaise is high-value per unit. Which is better over a full season?
Label: Question

Title: Re: Are Dinosaurs or Void Chickens better for profit?
Body: Void chickens are better for raw profit because they lay eggs every single day. Dinosaurs only produce an egg once every 7 days. Even with artisan profession bonuses, void mayo scales way better over time.
Label: Gameplay Tip

Title: Re: Are Dinosaurs or Void Chickens better for profit?
Body: Dinosaurs look way cooler on your farm though. Sometimes style points override the pure gold-per-day math. Plus, walking into a coop filled with tiny lizards never gets old.
Label: Opinion / Discussion

Title: Junimo Hut radius and trellis limits
Body: I'm redesigning my farm layout with Junimo Huts for Fall. What is the exact coverage area of a single hut, and can Junimos harvest grapes if they are on a trellis?
Label: Question

Title: Re: Junimo Hut radius and trellis limits
Body: The radius is 17x17 tiles, centered on the hut's door. And yes! Junimos completely ignore collision physics, so they can walk right through trellis crops like grapes or green beans to harvest them, which is amazing for tight layouts.
Label: Gameplay Tip

Title: Re: Junimo Hut radius and trellis limits
Body: Just keep in mind they won't work if it's raining outside, or during festivals. If you have crops that ripen on a rainy day, you'll have to manually pick them or let them sit until the next morning.
Label: Gameplay Tip

Title: Witch's Hut Shrines explained
Body: I finally got the magic ink back for the Wizard and unlocked his basement portals. What do the three shrines inside the Witch's Swamp actually do?
Label: Question

Title: Re: Witch's Hut Shrines explained
Body: The Shrine of Selfishness lets you turn your kids into doves for a prismatic shard. The Shrine of Memory wipes your ex-spouse's memory for 30,000g so you can talk to them normally again. And the Shrine of Night Terrors enables monsters on your farm.
Label: Gameplay Tip

Title: Re: Witch's Hut Shrines explained
Body: If you turn your kids into doves, look out for some creepy hidden Easter eggs on the TV or phone later on. ConcernedApe added some wild horror elements to that mechanic.
Label: Gameplay Tip

Title: Stardew Valley Expanded installation help
Body: I've installed SMAPI and Content Patcher, but SVE keeps throwing an error about missing tile sheets on startup. Am I missing a prerequisite mod?
Label: Question

Title: Re: Stardew Valley Expanded installation help
Body: You probably forgot to download Extra Map Layers or tight dependencies like Farm Type Manager. Check your SMAPI log at smapi.io/log and look at the red text lines; they tell you exactly which folder is missing.
Label: Gameplay Tip

Title: Re: Stardew Valley Expanded installation help
Body: Make sure you clear out old versions of SVE before updating to the 1.6 compatible versions. Dropping new files directly over old ones always messes up the JSON configs.
Label: Gameplay Tip

Title: How to trigger Krobus 14-heart event
Body: I've had Krobus as my roommate for two seasons now and his hearts are maxed out at 14. Is there a specific weather condition or location needed to trigger his final cutscene?
Label: Question

Title: Re: How to trigger Krobus 14-heart event
Body: Go to the beach on a sunny day between 8:00 AM and 5:00 PM. You cannot trigger it during the Winter season. It's one of the cutest cutscenes in the game, completely worth the void egg farming.
Label: Gameplay Tip

Title: Re: Best late-game money maker
Body: Ancient Fruit Wine aged in casks inside the cellar is the standard, but Starfruit wine aged to iridium quality technically has the highest single payout. Fill your entire island farm with starfruit and just rotate them through your house cellar.
Label: Gameplay Tip

Title: Re: Best late-game money maker
Body: Don't sleep on Dehydrators for high-volume crops like blueberries or cranberries. It processes 5 fruits at once and takes way less time than waiting weeks for a keg to finish spinning.
Label: Gameplay Tip

Title: Re: How to clear the Mutant Carp
Body: The Mutant Carp is in the sewers. You can catch it in any season or weather once you get the rusty key from Gunther. The water looks toxic but the fishing rules are identical to the mountain lake.
Label: Gameplay Tip

Title: Re: Slime Charmer Ring location
Body: You get the Slime Charmer ring as a reward from the Adventurer's Guild after killing 1000 slimes in the mines. It makes you completely immune to slime damage and the 'slimed' slow-down debuff, which makes Skull Cavern an absolute breeze.
Label: Gameplay Tip

Title: Re: What happens when you cut down giant crops?
Body: You have to hit them with an axe! They don't yield just one crop; they split into about 15-18 regular versions of the crop, meaning you get a net profit boost compared to harvesting them normally.
Label: Gameplay Tip

Title: Re: What happens when you cut down giant crops?
Body: Plus, giant crops never die at the change of a season. You can literally keep a giant pumpkin on your farm all through Winter as a permanent decoration if you don't chop it down.
Label: Gameplay Tip

Title: Re: Tea Sapling nerf in 1.6
Body: Yeah, Caroline's tea sapling strategy got nerfed hard. They used to sell for 250g, but now they only sell for 100g. It's still decent pocket change for Spring Year 1, but it's no longer a broken economy exploit.
Label: Gameplay Tip

Title: Re: Pan for iridium ore
Body: The copper pan is actually useful now since the panning spots drop lucky rings and artifact troves instead of just 2 copper ores. Keep it in your trash can or equip it on your head as a hat to save inventory space!
Label: Gameplay Tip

Title: Re: What does the prize ticket machine give?
Body: The machine inside Lewis's house follows a fixed reward track. You can look up the exact seed order on the wiki, but it rotates through starfruit seeds, mega bombs, mystery boxes, and unique house decorations.
Label: Gameplay Tip

Title: Re: How do I get to Ginger Island?
Body: You have to finish the Community Center first. Then Willy will send you a letter asking for help fixing his old boat in the backroom of his fish shop. Bring him 5 iridium bars, 5 battery packs, and 200 hardwood.
Label: Gameplay Tip

Title: Re: Mermaid puzzle on Ginger Island
Body: The stones correspond to the notes of the mermaid song from the Night Market. The large penny represents 5 beats and the small penny represents 1 beat. Adjust the blocks accordingly and run across them on a rainy day.
Label: Gameplay Tip

Title: Re: Best tree for tapping
Body: Oak trees for Oak Resin are the most critical early game because you need them to craft Kegs. Maple syrup is mostly for maple bars or gifting, and pine tar is just for speed-gro or looms.
Label: Gameplay Tip

Title: Re: Can you move the greenhouse?
Body: Yes! Just talk to Robin or use the wizard's magical construction menu. You can move the greenhouse to any valid clear space on your farm layout even if there are crops currently growing inside it.
Label: Gameplay Tip

Title: Re: What do mushroom logs scale with?
Body: Mushroom logs produce more and higher quality mushrooms based on the number of mossy trees or wild trees surrounding them. Grouping them inside a tight grove of oak trees maximizes your chanterelle output.
Label: Gameplay Tip

Title: Re: Deluxe Worm Bin vs Regular
Body: The deluxe worm bin doesn't just give regular bait; it creates deluxe bait which reduces the fish bite timer significantly faster and makes the fishing bar slightly larger. Essential for tournament setups.
Label: Gameplay Tip

Title: Re: How to get the Golden Clock fast
Body: Spam ancient fruit wine, use hyper speed-gro on your primary outdoor plots, and convert all your gold into diamond crystalariums. It takes 10,000,000g so you just have to streamline your sleep cycles late game.
Label: Gameplay Tip

Title: Re: Heavy Tappers worth the radioactive bars?
Body: Absolutely. They produce resin, syrup, and tar twice as fast as a standard tapper. If you have a massive oak tree grove setup, it pays for itself in a single season of processing.
Label: Gameplay Tip

Title: Re: Son of Crimsonfish location
Body: You can only catch the legendary variants like Son of Crimsonfish while you have the 'Extended Family' quest active from Mr. Qi's special order board. He spawns in the exact same spot on the East Pier.
Label: Gameplay Tip

Title: Re: How to get the Trash Catcher upgrade
Body: You need to complete the 'Clean Up the Ocean' special order for Linus. He'll teach you the Fiber Seeds recipe, which is incredible because fiber seeds grow in winter and don't require any watering.
Label: Gameplay Tip

Title: Re: Where is the Master Chef trophy?
Body: You have to cook every single recipe in the game. Check your collections tab to see which silhouettes are missing. Some recipes can only be bought from the Queen of Sauce reruns on Wednesdays.
Label: Gameplay Tip

Title: Re: Statue of True Perfection rewards
Body: Once you reach 100% perfection on the tracker inside Qi's walnut room, you get the Statue of True Perfection from the terminal. It spawns one pure Prismatic Shard every single day.
Label: Gameplay Tip

Title: Re: Can you marry the Wizard?
Body: Not in vanilla Stardew Valley. If you want to romance Rasmodius, you'll need to download mods like Stardew Valley Expanded or specific romance overhauls on Nexus Mods.
Label: Gameplay Tip
